topic: Captive coal-block economics for integrated steel/ferro-alloy majors (capex per tonne of linked capacity, payback period, typical cost-per-tonne delta vs market-linked coal)
whyItMattered: Needed to size the eventual margin impact of Shyam Metalics' Phutamura coal block investment (170MT reserves, production from July 2027) -- the filing discloses reserves and timeline but no acquisition cost or stake size.

topic: SEBI ICDR QIP 'objects of issue' disclosure norms -- whether use-of-proceeds detail is typically in the placement document rather than the closure/allotment filing itself
whyItMattered: Both PTC Industries (Rs 1,800cr) and TD Power Systems (~Rs 600cr) QIP filings this run disclosed size/pricing but not use-of-proceeds, blocking a real pat-bridge accretion/dilution read for either.
